The project region is considered the poorest province in South Africa and has the highest unemployment rate in the country at 47.1 %. Of the (estimated) 7.2 million inhabitants, over half are female (52.7 %). This is another reason why the main focus of the project is on women-led programmes and projects based on the so-called ABCD (Asset Based Community-driven Development) approach. This approach to community development focuses on peoples existing knowledge and skills rather than on their needs and shortcomings.
